deals to acquire Senso and Digital Audience, both announced in days of one another, should boost the marketing software company's omnichannel presence, RBC Capital Markets said.

“We like both acquisitions particularly as both companies are already integrated into the Zeta platform,” RBC analyst Matthew Swanson wrote in a note to clients. “Embracing emerging formats should help Zeta continue to operate as a true omni-channel platform, helping customers find their target audience across channels. We also like the company's continued investment into international markets by expanding deeper into Europe following its recent expansion into Canada and the UK.”
Swanson has an Outperform rating and a $40 price target on Zeta Global.
Aside from the deals, Swanson said he expects the company's Zeta live event to provide more details on the company's investments and strategic objectives, as well as new and existing partnerships.
Zeta Global shares fell modestly in Wednesday trading.

title: Zeta Global's deals for Senso, Digital Audience to boost omni-channel presence: RBC
